description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing scorecard entries in a survey platform. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, and filtering scorecard data related to surveys and clients, utilizing annotations for API documentation and dependency injection.

classes.name: ScorecardApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing scorecard entries for surveys and clients, providing endpoints for retrieval and creation of scorecard data.

methods.name: findBySurvey
methods.description: Retrieves a list of scorecard data entries associated with a specific survey.

methods.name: createScorecard
methods.description: Creates a new scorecard entry linked to a survey and client, based on provided scorecard data.

methods.name: findBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecard data entries filtered by both survey and client IDs.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves all scorecard data entries associated with a specific client.
